name: readable-contracts-and-tests
goal: People understand contracts and recorded input to output without reading JSON; exact data, errors, and evidence gaps stay available

evidence: Default contracts expose declared descriptions. Tests present named fields, typed values, lists and flat record tables; exact recordings remain available.
Five focused presenter tests failed before implementation: labels, tables, typed empty values and bounded previews were absent.
Generated shared RecordedValue using Harness. Contracts expose descriptions; compact typed previews preserve raw evidence, parser decisions, errors, and history.
Five original presenter regressions now pass. All fourteen report browser tests and twelve desktop evidence/browser cases passed, including typed values and separate current/commit views.
